questions.question: On the way to Jerusalem, Jesus said the Son of Man would be handed over to whom?

answers.text: The merchants of Tyre and Sidon

questions.question: When Jesus told His disciples He would be killed in Jerusalem, what did He say would happen on the third day?

answers.text: He will be raised to life
He will go back to Galilee
He will hide in the wilderness

questions.question: What did the mother of Zebedee's sons ask Jesus to grant her two sons in His kingdom?

answers.text: One at His right hand and one at His left
Both of them leading the other ten disciples
Both of them guarding the gate of His palace

questions.question: Jesus said the Son of Man did not come to be served. What did He come to do?

answers.text: Serve and give His life as a ransom for many
Rule and raise up an army to free the many
Judge and cast down the rulers of the Gentiles
